mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of months when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% for three consecutive months, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is above 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in residential construction permits (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate strong consumer demand and economic expansion, which drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through improved corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of months when both HOUST and RSAFS increase by at least 1% month-over-month, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of high unemployment (UNRATE > 5.0%), the labor market slack leads to reduced wage pressures and lower inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to maintain accommodative monetary policy, which supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of months when UNRATE > 5.0%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 90.0 for two consecutive months, it signals a contraction in manufacturing output and potential economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is above 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When residential construction permits (HOUST) exceed 900.0 thousand units for two consecutive months, it indicates a strong housing market and rising consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% year-over-year), an increase in the federal funds rate leads to a significant reduction in equity valuations due to higher discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of months when CPIAUCSL > 3.0% yoy and FEDFUNDS increases, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is above 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and increases in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicate a tight labor market and strong economic growth, which drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days through improved corporate earnings and reduced recession risk.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of months when UNRATE declines and PAYEMS increases by at least 0.5% month-over-month, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
